explanation: Wings is a silent film about First World War fighter pilots. The ceremony lasted about 15 minutes, and the winners had been announced three months earlier.

claims.text: Wings won the top award, Outstanding Picture, later counted as Best Picture, at the first Academy Awards in 1929.
The Jazz Singer received an honorary award at the first ceremony, The Broadway Melody won the top award at the second, and The Big Parade won no Academy Award.
Wings is a silent film about fighter pilots in the First World War.
The first Academy Awards ceremony lasted about 15 minutes.
The winners of the first Academy Awards were announced about three months before the ceremony.
